title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 14: Jeroboam's sick son and Ahijah's message, and the reign of Rehoboam in Judah when Shishak took the gold shields.

questions.text: Which son of Jeroboam became sick?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:1 says that at that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.

questions.text: What did Jeroboam tell his wife to do?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 14:2 Jeroboam tells his wife to disguise herself so she won't be recognized, and to go to Shiloh, where Ahijah the prophet is.

answers.text: Offer a sacrifice at the altar in Bethel
Send for the man of God from Judah
Disguise herself and go to Ahijah at Shiloh
Take the boy to the priests in Dan

questions.text: What did Jeroboam's wife take with her to the prophet?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:3 says she was to take ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey.

answers.text: A talent of silver and two robes
Ten loaves, some cakes, and a jar of honey
A young goat and a skin of wine
Five shekels of gold and some oil

questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:4 says Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

answers.text: He had been struck blind by an angel
His eyes had been put out in a war
It was night and the house was dark
His eyes were set because of his age

questions.text: What did Ahijah say when he heard the sound of her feet at the door?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:6 says that when Ahijah heard her feet, he said, "Come in, Jeroboam's wife! Why do you pretend to be another?"

questions.text: When would the child die, according to Ahijah?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 14:12 Ahijah says, "When your feet enter into the city, the child will die."

answers.text: When her feet entered the city
When Jeroboam came back from war

questions.text: Why would Abijah alone of Jeroboam's house come to the grave?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:13 says he only of Jeroboam would come to the grave, because in him there was found some good thing toward Yahweh.

answers.text: He was the firstborn son of the king
His mother had prayed for him
He had never bowed to the golden calves
Some good thing toward Yahweh was found in him

questions.text: In which city did the child die as his mother came to the threshold of the house?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:17 says Jeroboam's wife came to Tirzah, and as she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.

questions.text: What was the name of Rehoboam's mother?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:21 says his mother's name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

questions.text: What did Rehoboam make in place of the gold shields Shishak took away?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 14:26-27 says Shishak took all the gold shields Solomon had made, and King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place.
